contract.headline: CBH wins RM50.98 million solar EPC contract in Kelantan
contract.summary: CBH announced a new contract worth RM50.98 million for engineering, procurement and construction works on a 99.99-MWac solar photovoltaic project in Kelantan. Work commenced on 4 September 2026 and is scheduled for completion on 31 August 2027. The client was not named because of confidentiality provisions in the agreement.
contract.caution: Client identity was not disclosed. The Edge dateline is 18 Nov, but the article also says the company announced the news on Thursday (19 Nov).

contract.headline: Gamuda-led JV wins RM2.61 billion Keelung Underground MRT contract in Taiwan
contract.summary: Gamuda's 80:20 unincorporated joint venture with Taiwan's Feng Shun Construction Co Ltd received a letter of award from the Department of Rapid Transit Systems of the New Taipei City Government for a NT$21.02 billion (about RM2.61 billion) design-and-build contract covering 2.4 km of Keelung Underground MRT works, including stations SB32 and SB33. Gamuda's 80% share is about RM2.09 billion (NT$16.82 billion). The project duration is 2,700 days, or about 7.4 years.
contract.counterparty: Department of Rapid Transit Systems, New Taipei City Government

contract.headline: Vantris Energy JV secures RM1.7 billion Petrobras subsea contract offshore Brazil
contract.summary: An indirect 50%-owned joint venture with Paratus Energy Services Ltd, through Seagems Offshore, secured a US$410 million (RM1.7 billion) four-year contract from Petroleo Brasileiro S.A. (Petrobras) for pipelay support vessel and subsea engineering and installation services offshore Brazil. Vantris has an effective 50% share. The contract was signed on 16 November 2026. Work is expected to begin towards the end of the third quarter of Vantris's financial year ending 31 January 2029, using the Seagems Safira vessel still under construction.
contract.caution: Vantris's effective share is 50% of the contract value. Work is not expected to contribute until around late FY2029.

contract.headline: Steel Hawk bags RM59.24 million EPCC letter of award for Perak housing project
contract.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary Steel Hawk Engineering Sdn Bhd received a RM59.24 million turnkey engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning letter of award from Mimbar Nusantara Homes Sdn Bhd to build 240 houses across four phases of the Chemor Kayangan housing development in Kinta, Perak, on land for Lembaga Perumahan dan Hartanah Perak. Each phase is to be completed within 12 months of commencement.
contract.caution: Construction start dates were not disclosed.

contract.headline: Econpile secures RM21 million letter of award for Kampung Baru mixed-use works
contract.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary Econpile (M) Sdn Bhd received a RM21 million letter of award from KL City Gateway Sdn Bhd for earthworks and substructure works on a mixed-use development in Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur, comprising a 49-storey tower with 640 office units and 192 serviced apartment units. The contract is to be completed within 15 months from a commencement date to be set by the project architect.
contract.caution: The commencement date has not yet been fixed.

contract.headline: Sum Technology secures RM30 million provisional LOA for mechanical works in the Philippines
contract.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary Sum System Solution Sdn Bhd accepted a US$7.35 million (about RM30 million) letter of award for design-and-build mechanical works for a client in the Philippines aviation industry. The client was not named.
contract.caution: The contract value is provisional and subject to customer adjustments. The project timeline has not yet been fixed, and the client was not named.
contract.counterparty: Unnamed client in the Philippines aviation industry

contract.headline: Willownex bags RM28.8 million in Singapore security system contracts
contract.summary: Formerly known as Willowglen MSC Bhd, the group said its wholly owned Willowglen Services Pte Ltd secured three security and surveillance system contracts in Singapore worth a total of about RM28.8 million, all starting on 17 November 2026. Two were awarded by SP PowerAssets Ltd (RM10.45 million and RM6.83 million, both due by 16 November 2029) and one by Woh Hup Engineering Pte Ltd (RM11.97 million, due by 29 February 2028).
contract.counterparty: SP PowerAssets Ltd and Woh Hup Engineering Pte Ltd

contract.headline: LAC Med wins RM21.18 million contract to supply medical imaging equipment to three hospitals
contract.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary LAC Medical Supplies Sdn Bhd secured a RM21.18 million contract to supply, install and test angiography systems at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre, Hospital Melaka, and Hospital Raja Permaisuri Bainun in Ipoh. The group said the win lifted its outstanding order book to a record RM300 million. The three projects have 24-month contractual periods, with completion scheduled by the fourth quarter of 2028.
contract.caution: The immediate award came from an undisclosed local healthcare project partner, not directly from the hospitals.

contract.company: PMCK Bhd and Chin Hin Group Bhd
contract.headline: PMCK and Chin Hin sign binding term sheet for RM376 million Alor Setar hospital JV
contract.summary: PMCK and Chin Hin's wholly owned subsidiary Chin Hin Construction Engineering Sdn Bhd signed a binding term sheet to establish a joint venture to develop a 300-bed private hospital in Alor Setar, Kedah, at a preliminary cost of RM376 million, excluding medical equipment and loose furniture. CHCE would hold 80% and act as turnkey contractor; PMCK would hold 20% and be the exclusive operator. Construction is targeted to start in June 2027, with completion in December 2031. Separately, PMCK signed another binding term sheet with an indirect unit of Chin Hin Group Property Bhd (CHGP) to acquire a 2.78-acre lot in Melaka Tengah for RM8.48 million for another private hospital.
contract.caution: Stronger than a non-binding MoU, but still subject to regulatory approvals, final scope and contract sum, financing, and definitive agreements. The RM376 million cost is preliminary. Chin Hin Group's stock code is CHINHIN; Chin Hin Group Property's stock code is CHGP.
contract.counterparty: Chin Hin Construction Engineering Sdn Bhd / PMCK Bhd

contract.headline: Alam Maritim forms 70:30 JV with Singapore's Trident Oceanus for offshore projects
contract.summary: Subsidiary Subsea Worldwide Solutions Sdn Bhd signed a joint venture agreement on 13 November 2026 with Singapore-based Trident Oceanus Pte Ltd to undertake offshore transportation and installation projects in Southeast Asia and India. SWS will hold a 70% stake and Trident 30%, with initial paid-up capital of RM10,000. The company said the venture is not expected to have any material impact on the financial year ending 30 June 2027, but should contribute positively to future earnings.
contract.caution: This is a vehicle to pursue work, not a won contract. Stock code was not shown in the source article.

contract.headline: SkyeChip signs largely non-binding MoU with France's SiPearl for proposed Arm-based JV
contract.summary: SkyeChip signed a memorandum of understanding with France-based SiPearl SAS to jointly develop and commercialise a computing platform based on Arm Limited's Compute Subsystem N4 technology through a proposed joint venture in Malaysia, with SkyeChip holding 51% and SiPearl 49%. The companies aim to incorporate the JV by December 2026, subject to board approvals. The MoU will remain in effect for 36 months.
contract.caution: The MoU is largely non-binding and can be terminated by either party with 30 days' written notice. Stock code was not shown in the source article.

positive.headline: CBH announces record quarterly net profit of RM34.79 million
positive.summary: Third-quarter net profit more than doubled to RM34.79 million from RM12.54 million a year earlier. Revenue for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 surged to RM228.08 million from RM31.52 million, driven by its mechanical and electrical systems business. Nine-month net profit surged to RM77.52 million from RM28.38 million, on revenue of RM438.54 million. The group also announced a RM50.98 million Kelantan solar EPC contract, listed separately in the contract section.
positive.caution: The Edge dateline is 18 Nov, but the article also says the company announced the news on Thursday (19 Nov).

positive.headline: Inari 1Q net profit rises 18.5% to RM61 million, declares 1.5 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the first quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 18.5% to RM61 million from RM51.5 million a year earlier, with revenue up 13.1% to RM368.52 million on higher production volumes. The group declared a first interim tax-exempt dividend of 1 sen per share and a single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share, totalling 1.5 sen, payable on 8 January 2027.

positive.headline: Guan Chong posts record 3Q net profit of RM277.65 million, nearly seven times higher
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped to a record RM277.65 million from RM41.24 million a year earlier, despite revenue falling 38% to RM2.31 billion, as lower cocoa-bean costs and finance costs boosted margins. An interim dividend of 2 sen per share is payable on 18 December 2026, bringing the year-to-date total to 7.5 sen. Nine-month net profit more than tripled to RM654.25 million.

positive.headline: Kossan 3Q net profit more than doubles to RM87.41 million, declares 2.5 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped to RM87.41 million from RM37.83 million a year earlier, with revenue rising to RM671.12 million from RM438.98 million, driven by higher average selling prices and sales volumes. An interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share is payable on 18 December 2026. Nine-month net profit rose to RM191.41 million from RM104.64 million.
positive.caution: The Star headline says RM87.31 million; the article body, citing the Bursa filing, says RM87.41 million.

positive.headline: UEM Sunrise 3Q net profit more than doubles to RM48.75 million, declares 1.53 sen special dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 surged to RM48.75 million from RM18.49 million a year earlier, with revenue up 13.7% to RM474.88 million, helped by higher billings, stronger joint-venture earnings and lower finance costs. A special dividend of 1.53 sen per share is payable on 30 December 2026. Nine-month net profit surged 82% to RM111.8 million, while revenue grew 12% to RM1.43 billion.

positive.headline: Dutch Lady posts highest 3Q profit in 10 years, net profit up 26.3% to RM40.47 million
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped 26.3% to RM40.47 million from RM32.06 million, with revenue up 6.6% to RM399.26 million, driven by higher sales and foreign exchange gains. A second interim dividend of 40 sen per share is payable on 10 December 2026, bringing total dividends so far for FY2026 to 70 sen. Nine-month net profit surged 34.9% to RM108.6 million.

positive.headline: Hartalega 2Q net profit jumps 79.3% to RM32.8 million
positive.summary: Net profit for the second quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 79.3% to RM32.8 million from RM18.3 million a year earlier, with revenue up 19.5% to RM644.7 million, driven by higher average selling prices and improved operating efficiency. First-half net profit more than tripled to RM102.8 million from RM30.9 million, while revenue rose 14.4% to RM1.25 billion.
positive.caution: Stock code was not shown in the source article.

negative.headline: Zetrix AI says it cannot repay RM2 billion sukuk after missing a RM25 million payment
negative.summary: Zetrix AI told Bursa Malaysia it is currently unable to repay the RM2 billion outstanding under its sukuk wakalah programme after missing a RM25 million repayment. It also said the October 2026 suspension of the group and subsidiary MyEG Sdn Bhd as Road Transport Department (JPJ) revenue collection agents is expected to reduce group revenue by about 15%, with a direct impact on profitability. The company withdrew its 2026 interim dividend, is withholding RM49.76 million of outstanding final dividends, and is contesting RM353.13 million in Inland Revenue Board assessments. On 17 November 2026 it obtained an interim High Court order blocking Macquarie Bank Ltd from serving a winding-up petition over an unpaid RM2.06 million cash dividend.
negative.caution: Bursa Malaysia has directed settlement of outstanding cash dividends by 23 November 2026. The inter partes hearing on the injunction is fixed for 1 December 2026. Later court update: https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/826082

negative.headline: TSH 3Q net profit drops 68.5% to RM17.78 million after a RM42.5 million Indonesian fine
negative.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 fell 68.5% to RM17.78 million from RM56.41 million a year earlier, after an 84.35 billion rupiah (RM42.5 million) fine was imposed by Indonesia's Forest Area Enforcement Task Force on 90%-owned indirect subsidiary PT Sarana Prima Multi Niaga. Quarterly revenue rose 5.3% to RM277.69 million. No dividend was declared. Nine-month net profit declined 40.5% to RM91.58 million.
negative.caution: The company said core pre-tax profit excluding the fine was slightly higher, at RM89.34 million versus RM86.02 million.

negative.headline: Pos Malaysia 3Q net loss widens 37.6% to RM62.25 million, extending losses to 33 consecutive quarters
negative.summary: The national postal operator posted a net loss of RM62.25 million for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026, widening 37.6% from RM45.23 million a year earlier, despite revenue rising 8.3% to RM501.22 million. The wider loss included RM27.2 million of one-off vessel impairments and asset write-offs after the closure of Pos Shop. The group has been loss-making since the quarter ended September 2018.
negative.caution: Underlying loss before tax, excluding the one-off charges, narrowed 20.9% to RM31 million. The nine-month net loss narrowed to RM125.26 million from RM132.17 million.

negative.headline: Affin Bank says FY2026 PBT target of RM850 million and 5% ROE target are unlikely to be met
negative.summary: After a 21.7% year-on-year decline in third-quarter net profit to RM113.57 million, Affin Bank's management acknowledged that its FY2026 profit-before-tax target of RM850 million and return-on-equity target of 5% are unlikely to be met, amid deposit competition, margin pressure and elevated credit provisions. Net interest margin is expected to narrow further in the fourth quarter of 2026, and FY2026 credit-cost guidance was raised to 44 to 50 basis points.

negative.headline: Teo Seng 3Q net profit falls 16.4% to RM21.19 million; nine-month profit down 60%
negative.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 fell 16.41% to RM21.19 million from RM25.35 million a year earlier, despite revenue rising 7.93% to RM217.54 million, as the removal of the egg subsidy scheme weighed on its poultry farming business. Nine-month net profit fell 60.12% to RM43.29 million from RM108.57 million. No dividend was recommended for the quarter.

negative.headline: Heineken Malaysia 3Q net profit drops 38.74% to RM69.18 million
negative.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 fell 38.74% to RM69.18 million from RM112.95 million a year earlier, with revenue down 17.82% to RM539.14 million. The company cited lower sales volume, subdued consumer sentiment, the additional 10% excise duty implemented on 1 November 2025, and inventory normalisation among distributors and outlets. Nine-month net profit fell 29.53% to RM224.17 million. No dividend was recommended for the quarter.
negative.caution: News date is 11 November 2026, one day outside a strict seven-day window from 19 November.

negative.headline: S P Setia 3Q net profit drops 52.06% to RM32.61 million
negative.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 dropped 52.06% to RM32.61 million from RM68.03 million a year earlier, with revenue down 22.9% to RM672.55 million, due to slower sales, higher operating expenses, the absence of a land sale, and a higher comparative base from more project completions a year earlier. Nine-month net profit fell 31.11% to RM161.8 million. No dividend was declared for the quarter.
negative.caution: News date is 11 November 2026, one day outside a strict seven-day window from 19 November.
